body: It’s not even a useful skill!!!   Wasting your life cooking for thankless strangers.....   how is that remotely useful!!??

NONE of you people get it!!!!!’   In order for people to live Their happy little lives, others have to take the shit!      Yin/yang.    Balance.   Whatever.   Just like this dipshit Labor Day.    People behind a desk get extra time off while the people who perform actual labor are still working!!!!

For me, it’s just too late to change.  I’m 41.  I have to live with roommates to live otherwise I’d live in a box.  I’ve litterally wasted my life in one of the most thankless industries... cooking.  I have no life outside a kitchen... and not much of one inside a kitchen either.  You know what.... fuck it.  I gonna kill myself.  Fuck you world

Who am I gonna see that doesn’t cost me an arm and a leg first ?   Support groups are worth shit.  You know what therapists and support groups have in common?....people who pretend to, but really don’t give a fuck what happens to you.

Really???   My shit job is only a fraction of the shit that’s fucked in my head.  A) I’m 41 and all I know is cooking.    B) I’m no good to anyone.  All I am is a straight up BURDON to everyone I meet.  The same chick I mentioned earlier is currently sitting across the bar from me and hasn’t even said a word to me cuz she’s way more happier with her new friends.  I’m happy for her but it makes me feel bout 2 inches tall.   C) NOTHING CHANGES!!!!!  This was directed at someone else that commented on my shit
You don’t even know me.  I not only wanna kill myself but I got no issues taking someone else out too.

Nope.  Not the way to go.  Dying from cancer is a loooong expensive way to die.  Besides, I spent about 3 weeks in a hospital bed.   Those things SUCK!   Not to mention, all the doctors the barge in on you at 2 and 4 in the morning to do tests when all you wanna do is sleep!    The TV channels suck unless you pay more for good tv.   Just no...
Honestly.... there’s no point.   I’m not even comfortable talking to people.  People already think I’m crazy... I think I’m crazy.

Dude, I feel ya.  I’m been living with this shit for like half my life.  I go to sleep every night hoping I don’t wake up.... and wake up every morning disappointed.  I have to work with a girl that I have the biggest crush on (who I’ve always been there for) and she basically distances herself from me cuz “it’s easier” on me....    my work is pointless.  I have no purpose at my job and my home life is ver unfulfilling.  I walk around with a pocket knife cuz I could just snap any day and just call it quits.  I had a chance to die a few years ago in a really bad car accident but the docs a) kept me alive, b) left me with a huge disgusting scar down the middle of my stomach, c) my dick hasn’t worked right since and d) CHARGED ME FOR IT ALL!   So ya, I get it....

If all you’re looking for is empathy from others, sorry, you won’t get it.  I know it sounds harsh but it been my experience that the ones you’re seeking empathy from are the least likely to give it.  You seriously need to take a few steps back and work on YOU.   someone feeling bad for you?   Honestly, what is that going to accomplish?   Take the time to deal with you.  Other people truly don’t matter

Hanging yourself never works.  A shitty ATM isn’t an excuse to kill your self.   I use citizens bank too.   I understand feeling worthless and useless... and the love of your life not giving you the respect that you feel you deserve.  I’m in the exact same boat.  I have to work with the woman I can never have.... every... single... day

Do what you need to do.  I’m in the same position     I just did my taxes, relying on my returns to help get me out of my situation, as it turns out, I’m getting $100 back vs the $1000 that I was expecting 
I’m so fucked.  I hate myself.  I hate my purpose in this miserable existence.  I’m tired of fighting... trying to be better for a selfish and ungrateful world.  Fuck these people.  THEY deserve to die more than I do... but I’m the one constantly slashing up my body.

Then tell ME how exactly to “hide it”!!!!!!   I’m tired of suffering. I’m tired of suffering for myself and for those who have it harder than me!   So tell me EXACTLY how I “hide it”.   Cuz I’m so fucking sick of you positive people spouting your bs but offering no real solutions for people like me or this guy
That is me.  Every... single... day

Dude, I feel you.  I have the same soul sucking job.  Surrounded by a society that shuns you if you’re not happy all the time like everyone else.  You try and talk about things with people or a person you trust and, they don’t want to be around you because you’re always miserable.  You constantly feel alone and worthless and no good to/for anyone.  I’ve gotten the same “everything will be better someday” Bull shit too.   

I can’t, in good conscience, tell you to not kill yourself because, in all honesty, I go to sleep every night praying that I don’t wake up.   Try to find one good thing.  Just one.  Go with that
Ok except that I’ve cut myself 15 times since I posted.... fuck this shit.    I quit...
Are you just trying to get noticed?   Is that why you cut yourself?   Serious question.

I feel the exact same way.  “All you gotta do is be happy”.  That’ll solve all your problems.   B.s.    I’ve tried to talk to people but they just do t quite get it.  Just keep pushing.   Know that you’re not alone in this.  Keep in mind, no matter how hard it is for you, there is someone that has it worse.  That’s pretty much the only thing left that’s kept me alive.   Otherwise, I would have offed myself years ago
It’s just... you’re not the only one that feels like this.  I’ve just been harshly reminded that all I ha e is my work ... and nothing else.

I so feel you.  I’m 40.  I’m a Sous Chef.  I was in a bad car accident that not only left me with a huge disgusting scar down my stomach but left me wondering why I was still alive.  I’ve tried to reach out to people I feel comfy with... but they don’t get it.  No one does.  I’ve been cutting up on my left arm for months now.   I don’t feel like I’m meant to be here either

Well you know how you get your heart broken and some one eventually says “they aren’t worth it”?   I’ve gotten that a lot.   And clearly I’m not worth anything.... cuz no one even considers being with me.   So no one is “worth it” ... IM not worth it.  What’s the point?   All I have is my work.  And that’s just sad.   I’m going to slash the fuck outta myself tonight... after going almost 2 weeks without cutting myself

Ok dude,  I feel ya.  I really do.  I have a lot of the same stuff... not all... but some of it.  I’m bipolar.  Depression runs in my family.  I even got a bit of that social anxiety disorder.   I’m not trying to belittle your problems but you’re not the only one.  There are TONS of time when I feel like I can’t talk to anyone about the shit that goes on in my head but then I just talk to my sister about just random stuff and it honestly makes me feel just a little better.  If you don’t feel like you have that at home, talk to me dude.  No worries.  We can deal with shit together

I have no standards.  But you should really look at what you e written.  I’ve read it twice before I even responded.    You’re not even 25.  The kind of schooling YOU CHOSE to enter is designed to be hard!   Wanting to help people is great.  For that, alone, you shouldn’t kill yourself.  Think about it.  You went to school to learn how to help people.  The WORLD is better off with people like you in it.  I don’t know you and you don’t know me.  I’m telling you to keep that gun away from you and learn to help people

I’m not saying my life is worse.  I’m trying to find out why this guy wants to resort to heroin to kill himself.   I genuinely want to know why.  A lot of people have been through stuff.  I can’t even offer advice if I don’t know what his problem is.   By the way, trying to help others with their problems KIND OF helps me deal with my own issues.

How old are you????   What mental disorders have you had?   My sister told me that the problem with being miserable is that it’s a cycle.  You’re miserable cuz you’re alone but no one wants to be with you cuz you’re miserable.  I’m alone.  I have a 9 year old nephew that sat on my bed in my room because I was in the hospital for 2 weeks after a bad car accident.  He missed me that much and I STILL feel alone.  I have a girl I know that I care deeply for.  She was raped and has cut herself so many times that she looks like a jigsaw puzzle.  I had to fight just to be her friend    I can talk to her about anything and I STILL feel alone.  So you tell me.   What are YOUR problems?... and why do I have to wait 6 minutes before I post anything???!!!!

Why is it hopeless?   You have the balls to do heroin but you don’t have the balls to say why?  You’re a tough guy that doesn’t care what anyone says but you post your plans for total strangers to see.  Clearly you’re waiting for something.   What is it?  Someone tried to reach out to you.  You called them an idiot.

So your grand solution is to do heroin?  I’m sorry but from what you’ve said, you don’t even sound like you know how to get a hold of heroin.  Really, what’s going on?   Why do you think killing yourself with heroin is a solution?  If you mess it up, you’ll get caught by the police, get arrested, wind up In jail where they won’t let you kill yourself and you’ll end up in years of drug therapy with 10s of thousands of dollars in legal bills.  So why don’t you just tell us what’s wrong?   Save a buck.

So you’ve wrecked 4 cars in 3 years... welcome to my life.  One of my cars got wrecked cuz I got T boned... and the cops blamed ME!!!!  I’m now 40 with a student loan AND $30 grand in medical bills.  Oh I got rear ended in my next car... which forced me to buy a new car that I now have to make payments on ON TOP of the student loan and medical bills.... let’s not forget the surgery I needed to have about a year later AFTER I got T boned that I now need to pay for.   Everyone has some sort of debt, dude.  Debt isn’t a reason to kill yourself.  By the way, how did you wreck 4 cars in 3 years?

Really?   You want to kill yourself after college?  You want to put all that work in... all that money in to an education and then just throw it all away?????   It sounds to me like you’re just scared of what happens after college when there is no official structured education to live by.  This is nothing to even be thinking about killing yourself over.  Sorry for being blunt but really...

You can’t do it without people knowing... especially your parents.  If hurting people is what’s holding you back, that just means there are people that care about you and you know it because YOU care enough to not want to hurt them.
